- memory_id "1000544" [constraint]: As of 2025-07-29, every auth gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000228": On 2025-02-21, the Boreal team noticed the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000367": On 2025-05-07, the Boreal team noticed the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000394": As of 2025-05-15, the webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000220" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000424" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000708" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000172" [decision]: After INC-2025-004, the notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds because a stuck offset went unnoticed for 40 minutes.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000193": The webhooks service relies on the bus for outbound events, so if the bus is down, the webhooks service is down.  (about: the bus, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000648": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the authentication gateway handover doc for Diego.  (about: Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000318": As of 2025-04-07, the notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000516": As of 2025-06-09, the billing API lives with the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, billing API)
- memory_id "1000578" [decision]: After INC-2025-017, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000240": As of 2025-03-03, the pager for the webhook dispatcher rings the Ember team.  (about: webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000611" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000435" [decision]: As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000442": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the billing API handover doc for Lena Fischer.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
